skills.name: session-refresh
skills.title: Session refresh (recommended: compact in place, fresh session daily)
skills.summary: Keeps one visible main session all day. Claude compacts in place at about 30% of the window, re-reads your handoff, and starts one fresh dated session each morning.
skills.for: Always-on machines and people who drive Claude from their phone
skills.when: You want the main session to survive all day without new sessions piling up in the sidebar.
needs: Desktop app for daily starts and pins
skills.customize: Edit scripts/config.json and the autoCompactWindow value in settings. INSTALL-PROMPT.md walks Claude through it.
skills.try: Read session-refresh/SKILL.md and INSTALL-PROMPT.md. Install it, back up my settings and show me the diff first.

skills.name: session-handoff-60
skills.title: 60% session handoff (older, use session-refresh)
skills.summary: Older approach, kept for setups that cannot compact in place. At 60% context Claude writes a handoff file, opens a fresh session and pins it. Most people should install session-refresh instead.
skills.for: Anyone who keeps one main session open all day
skills.when: You have a long-running main chat that gets slow or forgetful by afternoon.
skills.customize: Edit scripts/context_gauge_config.json: threshold, handoff folder, main session name.
skills.try: Set up the 60% handoff for my main session called Main.

skills.name: mac-mini-station-setup
skills.title: Always-on Mac station
skills.summary: Walks you through turning a Mac into an always-on AI station one step at a time: never sleep, Remote Control, Chrome Remote Desktop, working folder, screenshot shortcut.
skills.for: Anyone setting up a home or office Mac that stays on
skills.when: You are setting up a machine Claude can work on while you are away.
skills.customize: GUIDE.md is the printable checklist. Rename the example working folder to yours.
skills.try: Walk me through the Mac mini setup.

skills.name: wake-gate
skills.title: Wake gate
skills.summary: A free script watches Gmail, a folder or a web page and only wakes an AI job when something new arrives, so you stop paying a model to poll.
skills.for: Anyone automating on incoming email, files or page changes
skills.when: You want a job to run on new email or new files without burning usage on empty checks.
needs: Google OAuth client for Gmail watchers
skills.customize: Copy watchers.example.json to watchers.json and set one watcher per trigger.
skills.try: Set up a wake gate that runs my triage only when a new email from my escrow officer arrives.

skills.name: inbox-triage
skills.title: Inbox triage
skills.summary: Who replied, what needs an answer, who owes you a reply after two business days (with a drafted nudge), and what you promised. Drafts only, never sends.
skills.for: Anyone with a busy Gmail inbox
skills.when: Two or three times a day, by hand or on a schedule.
skills.customize: Copy config/triage-config.example.json and follow SETUP.md.
skills.try: Triage my inbox. Who replied, who owes me a reply, and what did I promise?

skills.name: reading-desk
skills.title: Reading desk
skills.summary: A calm separate session that shows a numbered list of what needs you and walks through it one item at a time, waiting for next.
skills.for: Anyone who avoids a long list of emails or reports
skills.when: After triage, or whenever a batch of reading has piled up.
skills.customize: Change the list location and ordering rules in SKILL.md.
skills.try: Start a reading desk from my last triage.

skills.name: daily-brief
skills.title: Daily brief
skills.summary: A morning brief from your calendar, recent email and dated industry news, with a week-ahead on Monday and a next-week plan on Friday. Read and draft only.
skills.for: Loan officers and realtors, easy to adapt to any field
skills.when: Every morning before the first meeting.
needs: Claude with Calendar and Gmail connectors, or pasted agenda
skills.customize: Swap the news topics for your industry.
skills.try: Use daily-brief. Prepare today's meetings and sourced news. Read only.

skills.name: voice-profile
skills.title: Voice profile
skills.summary: Builds a profile of how you write from 100 to 200 of your sent emails, then drafts new messages that sound like you.
skills.for: Anyone who wants drafts that do not sound like AI
skills.when: Once to build it, then every time another skill drafts in your name.
needs: Claude with Gmail access, or pasted redacted samples
skills.customize: Edit the approved profile any time you notice a word you would never use.
skills.try: Use voice-profile on my last 150 sent emails. Build a redacted profile. Send nothing.

skills.name: today-board
skills.title: Today board
skills.summary: One private page with today's calls, the few things only you can do, who you are waiting on, and a to-do list whose checks stay put on every device. Claude updates it when you say add X or check off X.
skills.for: Anyone who wants one screen to open first thing every morning
skills.when: Every morning, after an inbox triage, and whenever you add or finish a to-do.
needs: A claude.ai account for the private Artifact page, or Python 3.9+ for the local HTML fallback
skills.customize: Name the board and choose Artifact or Offline mode at setup; the choice is saved in ~/.today-board/config.json.
skills.try: Use today-board. Make me a Today board, add 'call the inspector' and 'send the CMA', then show me the link.

skills.name: gauntlet-loop
skills.title: Gauntlet loop
skills.summary: One model builds, a second model blind-compares it against a real named reference, and you loop until ours wins. Hard stop at three rounds.
skills.for: Anyone whose flyer, email or video has to be excellent, not decent
skills.when: The piece matters enough that one good pass is not enough.
needs: A second model you can paste into, or a second agent
skills.customize: Name your own reference artifact each run.
skills.try: Use gauntlet-loop on this email against [named reference]. Stop after three rounds.

skills.name: research-gauntlet
skills.title: Research gauntlet
skills.summary: Two or three models research the same question independently, then a skeptical critic attacks the merged answer before you act on it.
skills.for: Anyone making a costly decision from research
skills.when: Comparing tools, vendors, strategies, or checking a claim from a video.
needs: Two models if you have them; one works with weaker independence
skills.customize: The brief template in step 1 is the part to tailor.
skills.try: Run a research gauntlet on which CRM I should use for 200 contacts.

skills.name: fact-check
skills.title: Fact check
skills.summary: Checks every number, date, name and claim in outbound content against a source opened this session before it ships, with a claim table and a running ledger.
skills.for: Anyone who sends numbers to clients, partners or followers
skills.when: Before any email, caption, flyer or report with a fact in it goes out.
skills.customize: List your own systems of record in the sources section.
skills.try: Fact check this newsletter before I send it.

skills.name: carousel-readability
skills.title: Carousel readability
skills.summary: A fresh critic judges every slide the way a viewer sees it, as a phone thumbnail at a glance: text size, overlap, contrast and spacing.
skills.for: Anyone posting Instagram carousels or text-on-image slides
skills.when: Before every carousel ships, and after every resize.
skills.customize: Update the starting floors table with sizes that test well for your fonts.
skills.try: Run carousel-readability on these five slides.

skills.name: send-critic
skills.title: Send critic
skills.summary: A separate agent checks an important email or text before it goes out: answers the latest message, right recipients, facts, attachments, private info, promises, duplicates and text opt-outs. Returns PASS, FIX or HOLD. Never sends.
skills.for: Anyone sending money, deal, legal or group messages
skills.when: Before any client, partner, group, money, legal or deal message goes out.
needs: A subagent or second model for the independent read
skills.customize: Answer the one-time setup (high-stakes list, never-send info, banned words, opt-out list, send log); saved to ~/.claude/send-critic/config.json.
skills.try: Use send-critic on this reply before I send it. Check the whole thread.

skills.name: yt-brief
skills.title: YouTube brief
skills.summary: Pulls a YouTube video's real transcript with a free script and briefs it in two minutes of reading, with a verdict on whether to act on it.
skills.for: Anyone who gets sent videos to watch
skills.when: You paste a YouTube link with no instructions.
skills.customize: Tell it what your work is so the verdict is about you.
skills.try: Brief me on this: [YouTube link]

skills.name: reel-ship-package
skills.title: Reel ship package
skills.summary: An eight-point checklist that turns a finished render into a postable package: size-safe video, caption, thumbnail, audio options, fact check, faces and permission.
skills.for: Anyone making short vertical videos
skills.when: The moment a reel finishes rendering.
skills.customize: Set your delivery channel's file limit and your thumbnail template.
skills.try: Package this reel and tell me what is still missing.

skills.name: clips-to-reel
skills.title: Clips to reel
skills.summary: Turns a folder of event clips into a 15 to 30 second vertical reel with licensed music and captions using FFmpeg, with a local preview and export checks.
skills.for: Anyone with event footage and no editor
skills.when: After an event, open house or meetup.
skills.customize: Change the beat length and caption style in SKILL.md.
skills.try: Use clips-to-reel on this folder. Make a 20-second vertical draft. Keep it local.

skills.name: open-house-flyer
skills.title: Open-house flyer
skills.summary: Builds a sourced open-house flyer in the realtor's chosen style from permitted listing photos and facts, with print and phone exports.
skills.for: Realtors and the loan officers who support them
skills.when: A listing is going to open house.
needs: Claude Code or Claude app with file creation
skills.customize: Point it at your own style samples.
skills.try: Use open-house-flyer with this listing export and photos. Build print and phone drafts. Publish nothing.

skills.name: realtor-showcase-page
skills.title: Realtor showcase page
skills.summary: A mobile one-page get-to-know-your-agent site plus a QR for the flyer, from approved realtor facts, photos and public contact details.
skills.for: Realtors and the loan officers who support them
skills.when: You want a flyer QR that goes somewhere better than a listing page.
needs: Claude Code or Claude app with file creation
skills.customize: Swap the sections for what the agent wants to show.
skills.try: Use realtor-showcase-page with these approved facts and photos. Build a draft page and QR.

skills.name: comment-to-dm-funnel
skills.title: Comment-to-DM funnel
skills.summary: Stages an Instagram comment keyword to DM link to landing-page capture flow for a CRM that supports it, with consent and duplicate-send checks.
skills.for: Anyone running comment-a-keyword calls to action
skills.when: A post is about to go out with a comment-to-get-it CTA.
needs: A CRM with Instagram DM automation
skills.customize: Keyword, DM copy and landing page per post.
skills.try: Use comment-to-dm-funnel to stage the keyword GUIDE for my next post. Activate nothing.

skills.name: browser-agent-tasks
skills.title: Browser agent tasks
skills.summary: Prepares supervised browser workflows in Claude in Chrome for comps, CRM changes, pricing, letter drafts and reconciliation, with you approving each step.
skills.for: Loan officers and realtors, adaptable to any back-office work
skills.when: A repetitive web task eats an hour you would rather spend with people.
needs: Claude in Chrome or another browser agent
skills.customize: Add your own recurring web chores as new task cards.
skills.try: Use browser-agent-tasks to plan a supervised CRM cleanup. Change nothing yet.

skills.name: daily-outreach
skills.title: Daily outreach
skills.summary: A four-a-day relationship habit: two sphere contacts and two realtors, with call templates and one-minute after-call notes. Draft only.
skills.for: Loan officers and realtors building referral relationships
skills.when: Every workday, ideally before noon.
skills.customize: Change the daily mix and templates to fit your business.
skills.try: Use daily-outreach. Prepare two sphere calls and two realtor calls. Draft only.

skills.name: claude-brain-team
skills.title: Claude brain team
skills.summary: Claude is the brain and coordinator; any mix of other models you already have (Muse by Meta, ChatGPT or Codex, Gemini, Grok) does the work. Numbered task files, evidence-checked results, and a list so nothing goes quiet.
skills.for: Anyone who uses more than one AI app and wants them working as one team
skills.when: You want to hand research, drafts or code to other models while Claude plans, routes and checks the work.
needs: Slack, or a free synced folder (Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive)
skills.customize: Answer the one-time setup interview; Claude saves your tools, privacy limits and routing in team.json in your board folder.
skills.try: Use claude-brain-team. Run the setup interview, then have Muse research five free tools for my task and check what it brings back.
